events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my simvastatin.
Thanks, one moment while I check.
Simvastatin is not active on your record, so I cannot send a refill request for it. I can route a question to the prescribing team if you want them to review it.
Well, can you just send it anyway? I still have the old bottle .

I cannot send a refill request for a discontinued medicine, but I routed your question to the prescribing team. Your reference is Q N, five nine five one, and the prescription record has not been changed.
